deadpan: A deadpan one-liner that states the absurd premise as plain fact.
hot-take: A confident, slightly unhinged hot take on the (trivial) topic that people will want to argue with. Never about real people, politics, or identity.
debate-bait: A question that dares people to disagree in the replies, e.g. 'Name one sponge that knew more. You can't.'
fake-outrage: Mock outrage, as if this trivial thing were a national scandal.
ranking-bait: Declare an 'objectively correct' opinion or ranking so people feel compelled to correct it.
confession: A deadpan first-person confession from the machine, related to the piece.
